publication_scope: Eight selected issues in seven NTE chapters, 2024–2026: 24 issue-edition cells reviewed, 19 positive records and five chapter-reviewed non-mentions. supporting_sources.publisher: Office of the United States Trade Representative
supporting_sources.title: Exchange of Letters, United States–Chile, June21,2024
supporting_sources.reviewed_content: The letters protect access against restrictions based merely on listed individual terms; set out the prior-user understanding; treat the exchange as integral to the FTA including dispute settlement. They specify entry into force90 days after the last notification of completed domestic legal procedures. The signing date alone is not the effective date.
supporting_sources.scope: Supplementary triangulation; not an NTE panel row.
supporting_sources.verification_method: Official web page/PDF opened and read; supporting material excluded from NTE record counts.

supporting_sources.publisher: Diario Oficial de la República de Chile / Ministry of Foreign Affairs
supporting_sources.title: Decreto191, November6,2024, published December20,2024; CVE2585103
supporting_sources.locators: PDF p1, recitals and artículo único
supporting_sources.reviewed_content: The decree promulgates the June21,2024 exchange of letters and states that entry into force is December29,2024. It cites a congressional approval communication, Oficio19.817 of September4,2024; that communication date should not be conflated with the Senate vote on September3.
supporting_sources.scope: Supplementary primary-source corroboration of entry into force; not an NTE panel row.
supporting_sources.verification_method: Official web page/PDF opened and read; supporting material excluded from NTE record counts.
